description: Independent choice, with label, description and selected or disabled states.

howToUse: Use it for an option that can be on or off regardless of the others: accept terms, receive news, one item of a list.
Write the `label` as the statement that becomes true when marked ("Send me the weekly summary").
Use `description` for the consequence, and `boxed` when each option is a row the person compares.
The change only takes effect when the form is saved.
alternatives: Only one option of the group can be chosen: RadioGroup.
A setting that takes effect right away: Switch.

props.name: label
props.description: Label to the right of the box.

props.name: tag
props.description:
Inline tag after the label (e.g. `<Badge tone="danger">destructive</Badge>`
on a dangerous permission). Slot: the atom does not bundle text.

props.name: meta
props.description: Mono meta on the right of the row (e.g. "42k clicks / 28d").

props.name: boxed
props.description:
Boxed variant: a selectable row with a border (property lists,
choices in a modal). The border lights up when checked.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
